tasks.task: Integrate explicit sunlight visibility into IRIS and run matched ablations
tasks.finding: EXP0025 reduced EXP0019's sun-attributable normalized-gap contamination from +18.4/+14.0pp to +0.83-1.71pp (non-monotonic, mixed vs SGS); EXP0026 fixed a bilinear kd/sun_irradiance coupling instability with a separate slower learning rate for the sun term, tightening the curve to +0.21-1.74pp and, at the matched 200-step budget, cleanly beating SGS-Intrinsic's magnitude (-0.43/-1.20pp) on BOTH heldout views (+0.21/+0.28pp)
tasks.required_fix: adding the explicit sun term alone was insufficient/actively harmful (two failed parameterizations made contamination 3x WORSE than vanilla IRIS); needed both (a) a within-segment albedo-consistency regularizer (EXP0025, since kd/albedo had zero spatial regularization in IRIS's has_part branch) and (b) a separate, slower learning rate for the global sun_irradiance parameter (EXP0026, to damp bilinear-coupling oscillation across step counts)
limitations: absolute albedo accuracy degraded (saturated/clipped) at every tested step budget, even after the EXP0026 fix

still non-monotonic across step counts (200/400/600/1000pp with EXP0026's fix: 0.21/1.18/0.65/1.74 avg) -- 200 steps is the best observed point, not a proven-optimal setting; no further hyperparameter grid search performed deliberately
sun direction is oracle (generator ground truth), not Mode B or ephemeris-recovered
does not yet touch emitter extraction/classification stage
